name: academic-pipeline
tagline_zh: 从查文献到终稿，10 步全自动。每步强制查重，两轮同行评审，质量关卡可复现。别处没有：审稿意见自动回炉修改。
tagline_en: From research to final draft in 10 automated stages. Mandatory integrity checks, two-round peer review.
desc_en: Orchestrator for the full academic research pipeline: research -> write -> integrity check -> review -> revise -> re-review -> re-revise -> final integrity check -> finalize. Coordinates deep-research, academic-paper, and academic-paper-reviewer into a seamless 10-stage workflow with mandatory integrity verification, two-stage peer review, and reproducible quality gates. Triggers on: academic pipe
why_zh: 同类工具只做单点，它把审稿意见自动改回稿子里，再送复审，形成闭环。质量关卡硬性卡死，不靠自觉。
why_en: Unlike single-step tools, it closes the loop: review feedback auto-feeds into revision, then re-review. Quality gates are.
